before_run: Record the trial worktree HEAD, branch, tracked path inventory, and clean index/worktree state.
Declare the sole output directory as trial-output/<opaque-packet-id>/ before execution.
during_and_after_run: Any tracked deletion, tracked modification, or staging/index change immediately invalidates the trial with TRIAL_WORKTREE_MUTATION_INVALID.
Any untracked file outside trial-output/<opaque-packet-id>/ immediately invalidates the trial with TRIAL_WORKTREE_MUTATION_INVALID.
Preserve the packet inputs and record the final HEAD, index/worktree state, tracked path inventory, and output file hashes.
